answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is requiring each agent to lock a bond before it can attest or earn. Spinning up thousands of fake agents then means locking real capital that gets slashed when peers flag bad answers. Weighting votes by each node's track record of verified rounds keeps one operator from drowning out honest peers. The bond acts as a canyon between cheap fake identities and real participation, guarded by a velvet rope. The steady pulse of verified rounds makes fraud expensive to sustain.
